name: FullStory
description: FullStory is an AI-powered behavioral analytics platform that captures real user interactions across web and mobile and converts that data into actionable insights for product, support, and marketing teams.
best_for: Product management, data analytics, customer support, and marketing teams in retail/ecommerce, food and beverage, travel, financial services, gaming, and SaaS who want to remove conversion friction and personalize digital experiences.
features: Session replay to record and play back real user sessions
Product analytics for behavior patterns and engagement metrics
Mobile analytics tracking interactions across mobile apps
Heatmaps visualizing where users click and scroll
In-product Guides and Surveys for feedback collection
StoryAI, an intelligence layer that surfaces insights from behavioral data
Fullcapture for automatic, privacy-first interaction recording

alternatives.name: Hotjar
alternatives.description: An experience-intelligence platform for understanding and improving user behavior on websites/apps.
alternatives.best_for: Product, design, and marketing teams wanting to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion.

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.
